name: Wilderness Fort
title: Wilderness Fort
summary: A fort near Zaikhal with NPCs and a Life Stone whose portals to Hebian-To and Zaikhal were destroyed in Shifting Gears; built like the walls of Bandit Castle (acpedia). In the kit: six two-storey wall buildings (7-8 m) forming a 46 x 64 m diamond on the flat z 240 plateau, with the Life Stone, a pool, glowing green plants and the two destroyed portals in wooden archways inside, and trees in the courtyards.

landmarks.name: Pool
landmarks.note: Pool spawn in the south courtyard.

site.name: Wilderness Fort
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer life-stone-at-23-5n-7-7w (south courtyard, next to the Life Stone). The acpedia/gazetteer name match '@tele 5.70N 4.30E' is the Mimiana Villas route start, not the fort.

shots.standingOrder: Rise straight up from 4 m outside the south point of the fort wall until the courtyard opens over it, pool and Life Stone below and the inner keep beyond; keep 15 m from the wall, creatures may be faded.
shots.notes: Boom rise over the south point of the fort walls: starting below the wall top (7 m), the camera climbs to 28 m and the courtyard with the pool, Life Stone, destroyed-portal archways and the inner keep opens behind the wall (lead-in by design until t 5.5). shots.standingOrder: Look straight down from 70 m on the diamond of fort walls, the pool, Life Stone and courtyard trees, turning 30 degrees and rising 10 m; nothing within 45 m, banderlings may be faded.
shots.notes: Bird's-eye of the Wilderness Fort: the diamond of Bandit-Castle-style walls, the pool, Life Stone and courtyard trees in the plateau grass, turning 30 degrees and rising 10 m.
